name.full: Kestrel Gale of the Final Stair

epithet: whose joy had no road home
mannerisms: pauses three beats before answering anything difficult
speaks of certain things only at dusk
will not say a name they have not earned
voice: careful and metered, as if each word were being paid for
aspiration: to feel that joy again, the one with no edges
fear: losing the last word in a language nobody else speaks
gift: they keep their word in conditions that release others from theirs
wound: the cousin whose name they cannot remember in the right language
secret: that they have been writing letters in another's name

threads.desc: who left without an argument, and whose silence {name} still rehearses answers to
whom {name} cannot quite forgive, and cannot quite stop calling
who appears in their dreams more often than makes sense

backstory.origin: Born in The Ascent, of the Final Stair, Kestrel grew up in a household where guests were rare, and treated like a small disaster.
backstory.weight: The line was elsewhere first. Kestrel's grandparents crossed a border in a year nobody in the family will agree on, and the country they left does not exist now in the form they remember it.
backstory.fracture: They were seventeen the night the singing did not stop. Kestrel found themselves inside something larger than themselves, and the memory of that warmth has organized every choice since.
backstory.between: Between then and now, they did most of the ordinary things. They lived in three rooms above a bakery for a time, learned the names of the local birds, and grew briefly close to a person whose name they will not say in mixed company.
backstory.present: These days, Kestrel can be found at the watch wall most mornings. They have a small icon they did not buy that they will not throw away, and a habit of walking three blocks past where they need to go that even their oldest friends find slightly strange.
